title: Why Odd Plus Odd Always Equals Even
description: A dot-pairing visual proof for why adding two odd numbers always gives an even result.
narration_lines: Why does an odd number plus an odd number always make an even number?
Take 5 dots. Pair them up: 2 pairs, with 1 left over.
Now take 3 dots. Pair them up: 1 pair, with 1 left over.
Those two leftover dots pair up with each other. 5 plus 3 is 8, fully paired, and even.
